children: Estonia seafood producer's Q4 revenue fell 8% yr/yr amid weak demand and price pressure
Q4 net profit driven by one-off gain from Saaremaa unit sale; underlying result was a net loss
Company sold Estonian production unit, shifting focus to higher value-added UK products
Company says focus in new financial year will be on improving UK operations' profitability
Company notes ongoing sector-wide challenges and raw material price volatility expected to impact results
Company enters new financial year with leaner management structure and simplified organisation
WEAK DEMAND AND PRICE PRESSURE - Co said Q4 results were affected by weak consumer demand, price pressure and uncertainty in the retail sector
LOWER PRODUCTION VOLUMES - Gross profit declined mainly due to lower production volumes in the Estonian production unit and volatility in raw material prices
SAAREMAA UNIT SALE - Sale of Estonian production unit formed part of restructuring plan, reduced cost base and enables focus on UK products
